note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 4724 Sections 4.2 and 5 after lint cleanup in rfc4724_collision_test.go (d3fcd1cfd7: dropped unused third return from setupEstablishedGRSession and replaced res.err != io.EOF with !errors.Is(res.err, io.EOF)). Producers detectCollision, peerAdvertisedGRFamilies, and finishCollisionHandoff are unchanged. TestRFC4724EstablishedGRCollisionClosesOldWithoutNotification establishes a real wire OPEN+KEEPALIVE session with GR capability carrying 1 AFI/SAFI (local BGP ID > remote BGP ID to isolate from RFC 4271 tie-break) and proves detectCollision returns (true, true) and finishCollisionHandoff closes the old TCP session silently (0 bytes, io.EOF) while retaining the new connection; negative subtests prove no-GR and 0-family empty GR return (false, false) and reject the new connection with NOTIFICATION Cease/Connection Collision (6/7) while leaving the old session open.
